title: Charged particles and magnetic confinement
description: The Lorentz force bends charged particles into circles and helices; a magnetic mirror and a ring-shaped field show how a plasma can be held, and why the real, collective plasma is much harder to confine.

sources.title: Lorentz force (Wikipedia): the force on a moving charge and its direction
